title: mcp
description: Weather, climate, terrain, fire and flood risk data for any point or polygon on Earth. Free tier.
summary: Weather, climate, terrain, fire and flood risk data for any point or polygon on Earth. Free tier.
offersHint: Weather, climate, terrain, fire and flood risk data for any point or polygon on Earth. Free tier. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://pixelgust.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_current_weather
toolsPreview.description: Current weather conditions for a point: temperature, humidity, dewpoint, wind speed and direction, precipitation, pressure, cloud cover, solar radiation, plus terrain, land cover, NDVI, population density, and soil context. Source: NOAA GFS 0.25 degree, updated every 6 hours.

toolsPreview.name: get_weather_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Daily weather forecast for a point, up to 7 days ahead. day=0 is today, day=6 is six days out. Returns daily mean, min, and max per variable.

toolsPreview.name: get_historical_climate
toolsPreview.description: 10-year historical climate averages (2015-2025, ERA5 reanalysis) for a point. Omit month for the annual average, or pass month 1-12 for that month's climatology with min and max ranges. Use this for questions about typical climate, growing seasons, or what weather to expect at a location and time of year.

toolsPreview.name: get_climate_timeseries
toolsPreview.description: Monthly time series 2015-2025 (about 130 monthly values) for one variable at a point, plus the 12-month climatology. Variables: temperature_c, precipitation_mm, dewpoint_c, skin_temperature_c, surface_pressure_hpa, snowfall_cm, total_evaporation_mm, soil_water_layer_1_vol, wind_speed_ms, net_solar_radiation_mj_m2, relative_humidity_pct, cloud_cover_pct, ndvi, fire_weather_index. Use for trend questions (is it getting hotter or drier here?).

toolsPreview.name: get_terrain
toolsPreview.description: Terrain for a point: elevation, slope, and aspect at 30m resolution (Copernicus DEM), plus Topographic Wetness Index (flood susceptibility indicator).

toolsPreview.name: get_hazards
toolsPreview.description: Natural hazard indices for a point: Fire Weather Index (current danger), soil erosion risk (RUSLE, t/ha/yr), and flood susceptibility (Topographic Wetness Index).

toolsPreview.name: get_environment
toolsPreview.description: Environmental data for a point: NDVI vegetation index (300m), annual evapotranspiration (MODIS), and ESA WorldCover land cover class.

toolsPreview.name: get_proximity
toolsPreview.description: Distances in km from a point to the nearest city, airport, port, hospital, power plant, and other key infrastructure.

toolsPreview.name: get_polygon_stats
toolsPreview.description: Aggregate statistics (mean, min, max, std) over a polygon area: weather, terrain, hazards, environment, soil, and population. Coordinates are [longitude, latitude] pairs forming a ring. Maximum area depends on plan (free tier: 100 km2). Use for area questions such as average slope of a farm or population inside a zone.
